body.name: Modulus handle for exact expected-length optimality
body.construction: At \(\Delta_T=0\), use the observed-experiment modulus generated by common-policy likelihood paths and hidden-sign tail perturbations, then optimize worst-case \(\mathbb E_{P,\Pi}\)-length over all \(O_{T,0}\)-measurable uniformly honest intervals for \(\tau\), where the expectation integrates over outcome-delay arrivals under \(P\) and any randomization induced by \(\Pi\), to characterize \(\mathcal C_\eta^*(\alpha,\beta,L,c,C,\varepsilon)\).
